decision: Useful removal and alignment API verified at bounded component level. Not full product or library acceptance; one new strict-Clippy regression must be repaired. Existing functional and architecture gaps remain blocking acceptance.

findings.kind: Remaining prohibited production mechanism / library gate
findings.evidence: launch_cockpit_scene still selects the replacement full-screen painter only for Route::Cockpit, Motion::Paused, Scenario::LaunchRunning and frame()==40; draw calls it at 9420 after ordinary shared screen composition. Expanding this painter to 120x40 removes tables but preserves captured-condition selection of a different screen implementation.
findings.related: crates/jackin-preview-app/src/app/launch_cockpit.rs:21 accepts whole App, builds raw Buffer and cell-blits it; literal ROLE/WORKSPACE/AGENT/CREDENTIALS, fixed SPINNER at19, rain frame40 at108, fixed-column bold patches at51-72, raw color downgrade/fade at599 remain. These are evidence of private screen/component mechanics, not reusable Termrock composition.
findings.attribution: Private painter and predicate pre-exist; this increment expands that path to the formerly replayed 120x40 scene.
findings.fix: Use semantic app-owned view data/actions with shared steps/status/button/chrome/layout blocks; remove the captured scenario/frame predicate and fixed correction painter when real shared components pass paired tests. Do not merely relocate this module into Termrock or restore removed tables.

findings.evidence: Debug info is generic Dialog::info with static Vec<String> paint_lines, updated at3131 and drawn at8664. Frozen cockpit.rs:421 uses InfoDialog with PropsList, read-only meta and copyable Container/Run id; frozen info_dialog.rs:204 forwards navigation/copy; props.rs:473 moves cursor and emits Copy. Exact real-App Down probe and y on all eight attempted rows fail both before and after49da; no selection change or clipboard copy.
findings.attribution: Pre-existing missing mechanics exposed by replacing replay with live rendering; no claim this increment first introduced them.
findings.fix: Reuse current public PropsList/PropsState/PropsRow/PropsAction::Copy(ItemKey), preserve stable keys and copyable domain values, and add typed composition adapters described below. Keep navigation, selection and scrolling in PropsList; map typed copy key to app-owned value and existing clipboard service.

findings.evidence: Real-App i opens Debug info; x while info remains open also opens cancel dialog. Same unchanged probe fails on exact adf334 and49da. CMD_COCKPIT_CANCEL uses capture-phase app key binding and checks route/failure/cancel_open, not the active modal scope.
findings.attribution: Pre-existing on exact predecessor; not attributed as a new49da regression.
findings.fix: Repair shared command/input scope ownership so background route commands cannot act through an active modal. Do not scatter popup-open checks into each app command. Preserve allowed modal-owned actions and focus restoration; add real component/app regression.

findings.evidence: New unqualified ScreenAlign import makes existing termrock::ScreenAlign::Center unnecessarily qualified. Candidate scoped strict Clippy reports ten errors including this unused-qualifications error; exact predecessor reports the same other nine errors but not this one.
findings.fix: Use the imported ScreenAlign consistently (or avoid the import), then rerun exact scoped checks. Preserve and separately resolve the other nine existing lint failures.

retained_progress.removed_mechanisms: historical_cockpit_info.rs, historical_cockpit_cancel.rs, launch_dialog_plate.rs, presentation launch_running.rs and its export removed; no remaining Rust source references to their deleted renderers found. Commit49da reports 7794 deletions. No tests or expected snapshots changed by this increment.
retained_progress.real_dialog_path: Cancel and info draw unconditionally through ui.layer and shared Dialog at every size/profile where app draws layers. Old plate predicates and explicit skip of shared modal painter removed.
retained_progress.alignment_api: Dialog::align(ScreenAlign) is additive; field is private, constructors initialize None, omitted alignment resolves to exactly existing modal default Anchor::Screen(Center). Explicit GeometricCenter changes only layer anchor; measurement/update/draw renderer remain existing implementation. Scoped Overlays strict Clippy and both changed-package formatting pass.
retained_progress.real_functional_progress: Unchanged real-App cancel x/Right/Enter confirmation now closes modal and shows Launch cancelled; same probe fails adf334. Four-profile adjacent-size resize/open-close/keep-launching matrix passes49da and fails predecessor. These are bounded functional improvements, not exact frozen frame proof.

available_shared_repair_contract.existing_api: termrock-controls/src/props.rs exposes PropsList, PropsState, PropsRow and typed PropsAction::Copy(ItemKey), reexported via navigation/facade. No current shared InfoDialog type was found.
available_shared_repair_contract.low_level_proof: External props_slot.rs consumer uses existing Dialog::draw body callback with PropsList::draw, Dialog/PropsList update once each, and LayerSpec::initial_focus(props_id). Down selects stable key17, y emits Copy, Tab reaches close control, ShiftTab restores property focus, Esc closes. Passed. Dialog.update does not force its close button over explicit initial_focus for info dialogs. Body callback executes via ui.with_area within current modal layer; PropsList registers real control/bindings in that scope.
available_shared_repair_contract.composition_gap: Low-level proof alone does not satisfy Goal consumer API. termrock/src/slots.rs has PickerSlotExt only; composition.rs has button/tabs/steps/editor adapters, no PropsList or Dialog body-slot adapter. Runtime LayerSlot::new is pub(crate). Application must not acquire new Rect callback helper to cover this gap.
bounded_owner_plan: Shared composition/runtime author-API owner adds the minimal typed Dialog layer/body-slot wrapper and PropsList composition adapter, delegating existing measure/draw and retaining layer/owner/state identity; any nested slot constructor belongs to the component-author boundary. No second painter or input system.
Existing PropsList owner verifies focus, copy, scrolling, empty/long/Unicode rows and disabled/inactive states with different data, plus published cursor/part behavior. No Jackin-specific variants.

Jackin application owner supplies property data/stable keys, copyability and domain copy action. Its view composes through public typed slots and holds PropsState; no private property navigation or raw painting.
Shared runtime command-scope owner repairs capture-key modal barrier separately. Test exact i/x sequence plus explicit modal actions, dismissal/focus restore.
Retain the unchanged RED probes, then require GREEN on repaired source and separate frozen paired CLI checks; do not bless current output.

predecessor_native_reproduction.result: Both same failures and same cursor actual/expected pairs independently reproduced. This filtered reproduction is not a full native gate.

cases: Dialog default Center versus explicit Center/GeometricCenter anchors and vertical positions over zero/narrow/adjacent and resized windows

test_results.external_probe_notes: Probe packages are external artifacts only, not production edits. Some discarded fixture Responses produce unused-must-use warnings. Initial stronger alignment assertion incorrectly assumed floor rounding for Ratatui horizontal centering; removed that unsupported arithmetic assumption, preserving anchor and vertical-position checks. Initial log preserved. Harness catches/retries AreaChanged during backend resize; resulting settled Harness pass is not independent proof of production resize prepare/dispatch invariants.

coverage_gaps: No frozen paired real-CLI tuiscotti captures were executed in this review. No claim of exact cell/color/attribute/cursor shape/timing parity.

Pointer press/drag/release and outside-click policy, functional copy exact value, all routes, data permutations, empty rows, covered-state styling, terminal modes/cleanup and full focus restoration remain unverified here.
Runtime backdrop allocation/provenance repairs separately owned and not reviewed here.
All other replay/private application UI paths remain outside this bounded delta; this review does not approve them.
Full workspace nextest/lint/format/product gate is not green.
